In addition to releasing the first public betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple has also simultaneously launched revised versions of these developer betas, featuring new build numbers. Details below.

Revised versions released alongside the public betas

Along with the launch of the first public betas, Apple has also released revised versions of the developer beta 3 for iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate.

The revised iPadOS 27 developer beta 3 uses build number 24A5380l, while the updated macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 3 uses build number 26A5378n.

The reason behind Apple releasing these revised versions remains unclear, as no widespread serious issues were reported with the previous versions. The modifications may have been made to address issues discovered before today's public beta release, but Apple has not provided any details.

That said, we will keep a close eye on these new builds and report back if anything noteworthy comes up.

Have you found anything new in the revised versions? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
